description: dispatch --dry-run --exclude-vendor VENDOR drops every chain entry of that vendor before availability is even checked (accounts.py candidates(), SkipCause.VENDOR_EXCLUDED) and falls to the next entry for free: this skip cause is budget-exempt, so it never spends a role's degrade_once allowance (that is exercised separately by dispatch-degrade-once-budget). --exclude-vendor is repeatable (argparse append); one value is enough to show the mechanism.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.seat-a]
kind = "codex"
short = "sa"
vendor = "chatgpt"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home-a}}"
pool = "chatgpt:excluded"

[accounts.seat-b]
kind = "codex"
short = "sb"
vendor = "codex"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home-b}}"
pool = "codex:floor"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[projects.sandbox.chains]
explorer = ["seat-a", "seat-b"]

[roles.explorer]
write_scope = "none"
effort = "low"
on_exhausted = "degrade"
skills = []

[roles.explorer.models]
codex = "gpt-test"
